rules.sentence: Etranacogene dezaparovovec offers a one-time treatment option for adults with hemophilia B who use factor IX prophylaxis but still experience severe bleeding.
Replacing factor IX continues to be the primary treatment for patients with hemophilia B, with the dose determined by the severity of bleeding.

The goal is to achieve 30% factor activity in patients with mild hemorrhages, 50% in patients with severe bleeding after trauma or those who need prophylaxis before major dental surgery or other surgery, and 80% to 100% in patients with life-threatening conditions.
